basic_info.description: Authentic 1929 Portola District Home – Classic Charm Meets Endless Potential  Welcome to this rarely available 1929 single-family residence, nestled in the heart of San Francisco’s sought-after Portola District. On the market for the first time in over 20 years, this home offers original architectural details and the opportunity to create something truly special.  The property features 2 generous bedrooms and 1 bathroom with a separate tub and shower. Retaining much of its original layout, including a vintage kitchen and bath, it’s ideal for those who appreciate classic details or are ready to make thoughtful updates.  A spacious, sunlit living room showcases original hardwood floors and an oversized brick fireplace. The home also features a kitchen with a separate breakfast nook and a formal sunlit dining room with French doors, enhancing its warm and inviting atmosphere.  Central heating and a cavernous garage with 17-foot ceilings offer room to grow—whether you're considering expansion, additional storage, or a creative studio.  The backyard provides ample space and potential to design the outdoor area you envision.  Situated on a 2,996 sq ft lot near John McLaren Park, major transit lines, and freeway access, this home is delivered vacant.
